name: [UPD] Snipers [BETA]
desc:
💥 Welcome to Snipers! 💥

What is Snipers? Snipers is a long distance shooter game, you spawn with a sniper and fight other people to the death! Sniper Fight, Get To The Top Of Leaderboard, Buy More Guns, No Scope People, roleplay, or explore the map.

Press SHIFT while a weapon is equiped to sprint!
Press R to reload your weapon!
Press G to use the glider!

*Rejoin after buying a gamepass* ➡️

If you enjoyed this game, don't forget to 👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite, and 🔔 Follow!
